published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Undead (follows its base build, warrior__arms); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 940.0 as Orc on the same sim)

summary: Arms with Spearing Strike and Improved Bloodrage, for a Giant or Dragonkin boss such as Onyxia.
advantage: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin, so it earns a place in the rotation.
advantageShort: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin.
rotation: Pre-pull: Battle Stance, then Charge for 15 Rage
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
With 25s left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance, and back to Battle Stance once Recklessness is out
Recklessness in the last 25s; racials on cooldown
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 15s; Bloodrage under 20 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15s cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 90 Rage, Hamstring filler from 30 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Spearing Strike only works against Giants and Dragonkin
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate at every level.
No Fury Dragonkin build: Spearing Strike adds only 0.4% (dual wield) and 0.8% (two-hand).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 8.4 vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 9 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__arms except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeDragonkin, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29) (follows its base build, warrior__arms), was Orc.
